## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T12:01Z

Read fresh. The Studio Data pillar's Records grid draws fewer rows than its footer counts, with a stretched empty band before the last drawn row. It was seen twice:
- the skeleton PR's committed screenshot on `main` (`crm_account`, 10 records: rows 1–8, a gap, row 9, no row 10);
- the #12450 dev's local console (6 of 9 drawn).

An 8-row object did not reproduce it. It is not root-caused.

**Grade p2:** records an author expects to see are not drawn, on the redesign's main surface.

**Lane `domain:ui`:** the candidates are `renderStudioGridList`, `ListView` and `ObjectGrid`.

**Scope:**
- First, root-cause it, and measure whether console list pages show the same thing. If they do, the card says so and the fix covers both.
- **Pins:**
  - a 10-row object draws 10 rows with no gap;
  - CONTROL: the 8-row case is unchanged.
- Not part of epic #12446 (the filer's line), so it is dispatched by the lane, not reserved.

`finding` leaves on grading.

Measurement for the claimant (seat `domain:ui#2`, claim `6192866372`). This seat measured it in a local console while walking HotCRM. No code was written. Readings are from 2026-10-15T13:52Z on objectui `d4bc81e` and HotCRM `63db83e`; line numbers were re-read on objectui `03cf7b2`. **The rows are not missing. One row is tall and pushes the others below the fold.** - Studio, `crm_account`, 1280 × 900. The footer says 9 records (today's seed has 9). Rows 1–6 are 41 px tall. - Row 7 (Acme Corporation) is **457 px** tall. That row is the "empty band". - Rows 8–9 sit below the fold of `data-table-scroll-box` (clientHeight 674, scrollHeight 832). - All 9 rows are in the DOM, and `GET /api/v1/data/crm_account` returns 9. - No virtualizer is on this path. The rows are static ``, and the path is ListView → ObjectGrid → data-table ``. **Cause: a block-level cell inside a one-line clamp.** - The tall cell is the Description column, a `markdown` field (HotCRM `src/sales/objects/account.object.ts:316`). - Acme's seed value (`src/sales/data/sales.seed.ts:206`) is 1228 characters long, with several paragraphs and bullet lists. - `MarkdownContent` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/richTextDisplay.tsx`, `MarkdownContent.tsx`) renders the whole GFM document as block elements: about 20 `

` and `

  • `, 444 px tall. - data-table puts it in the `'truncate w-full'` wrapper (`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx:3690`; the renderer is called at :3701). `truncate` clamps inline text only, so block children still stack. - The `
    • ` gets `h-9 … overflow-hidden` from `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:4894`. As its own comment says, `h-*` is a minimum height, and neither class caps a table cell. **What triggers it** (response intercepts, nothing written): | Acme description variant | Row height | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | Cut to one paragraph | 41 px | every row 41 px | | Moved onto Stark Medical | 456 px on Stark | Acme's row drops to 41 px, so the fault follows the value | | `First.\n\nSecond.\n\nThird.` on Globex | 113 px | | | One 1500-character paragraph on Globex | 41 px | | So the trigger is any multi-block markdown, html or richtext value. Row count and viewport height only decide where the tall row lands, which explains the earlier "8-row object did not reproduce" reading. **Console list pages show it too, when the column is present.** - HotCRM's `all_accounts` view does not select `description`, so the shipped Accounts list is all 41 px. - With `{field:'description'}` added to the view client-side, the same list reproduces: Acme's row is 457 px and row 9 drops below the fold. The fix in data-table / ObjectGrid therefore covers both surfaces, as triage's scope asked. **Seen in passing, not measured further:** after scrolling the Studio grid, body row 4 drew over the frozen header cells. It may be a separate stacking issue. Check it while you are in that file. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12502 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-15T14:12Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `256cd24`, against triage's scope (`6191568983`) and the claim (`6192866372`), not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`. Its body opens `Fixes #12480`, the only closing keyword, followed by `Clause-②: no`. 3 files.
- **Root cause, measured (triage's first ask):**
  - `data-table` clamps a cell to one line with `truncate`, which bounds inline content only.
  - The `markdown`, `html` and `richtext` cell renderers draw a block document, so one long rich value grows its whole row. In Chromium at 1280×900 on HotCRM's `crm_account` shape, one long markdown `description` made its row 456 px tall. Its cells sat centred in that row, which is the "gap", and the rows after it fell below the scroll box while the footer still counted them. The committed screenshot matches: row 9's text sits at y 815 = 586 + 456/2.
  - The trigger is the content, not the row count: an 8-row object with one such value reproduces it.
  - PR #12479 is not the cause (`cf430cd`, the screenshot's base, is an ancestor of its merge commit).
- **Console pages, measured (triage's second ask):** the console `ListView` body shows the same 456 px row, through the same `ObjectGrid`, so the one fix covers both.
- **The fix:** `ObjectGrid`'s `applyColumnChrome` gains one step, `withOneLineRichText`. A column whose resolved renderer is in `@object-ui/fields`' existing `RICH_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES` table, and is not authored `wrap: true`, has its cell output wrapped in a `line-clamp-1` box. The renderer and its sanitiser (the trust boundary) are unchanged, and so is the record-detail drawer. `wrap: true` keeps the whole document, as authored.
- **Readings (Chromium):**
  - Studio slot: 8, 9 and 10 rows go from 7/8, 8/9 and 9/10 inside the box to 8/8, 9/9 and 10/10, every row 41 px.
  - Console `ListView`: every row 36 px.
  - Plain-text CONTROL: unchanged, 10/10.
  - Per type before the fix: `html` 176 px and `richtext` 104 px; the other renderers stayed at one line (16–32 px).
- **Pins and ablation:** 3 pins, plus the existing `columnWrapForward` pins (8/8). An unconditional pass-through turns the pin red and puts the browser row back at 456 px. Restore was proven by blob hash.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/plugin-grid: patch`. No new prop or export.
- **Evidence:** `packages/plugin-grid/` gives 2015 tests passed. The closure build and plugin-grid type-check exit 0, and so does the battery. Narrowed eslint shows 1 pre-existing `react-hooks/static-components` error, the same as the base blob.
- **Acceptance notes (not filed):**
  - A rich-content column authored `wrap: true` still grows its row (the author's choice).
  - The phone card layout and the kanban and gallery cards, which draw the same renderers, were not measured.
  - A dotted lookup-path column has no field definition, so it is not clamped.
- **CI at head:** 34 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 37 runs), all 16 test shards included.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
